title: Secret Lair Drop Series: Summer Superdrop 2023

entities.name: Syr Konrad
entities.description: Knight called the Grim in a poem who rode to war and slew ghasts and ghouls, then was unseated and dragged into hell.

entities.name: Mindrazer
entities.description: Joined the fray and unseated Syr Konrad.

entities.name: Wheel of Misfortune
entities.description: Instrument to which Syr Konrad was bound.

events.summary: Syr Konrad rode into war and slew the horde of ghasts and ghouls.
events.quote: The inhuman horde fell to his sword

events.summary: When the Mindrazer joined, Syr Konrad was unseated and bound to the Wheel of Misfortune and dragged into hell.
events.quote: Bound to the Wheel of Misfortune And slowly dragged into hell.
